operator: Root alone. Reviewer executed no authored graph/controls/reuse/owner helper, compiler, validator, provider, device, API, test or CI.

archive.scope: Parse-only exact completed module reuse; original failed wrapper false and child1 preserved. No compiler, validation, provider, arithmetic or performance execution.

scope.prospective_operations: Pin clean source context→one parse-only owner read-completed-endpoint→separate post-terminal review.

pointer_alias_proof.limited_to: One exact Function PB32Wide{uint,uint} variable and two direct typed uint access chains.
pointer_alias_proof.duplicates: Only one or two typed immutable CompositeExtract values of the exact product field are equated; arbitrary memory or SSA identities are not collapsed.

control_flow_proof.all_actual_successor_forms: OpBranch, OpBranchConditional and OpSwitch default/case successors are accounted for in predecessor sets.
control_flow_proof.closed_choices: Only exact Select/Logical operations or two-incoming structured selection Phi diamonds are recognized. Each simple arm has only its owning header as predecessor and returns to the exact merge; nested choices require previously proved entry/merge relationships.
control_flow_proof.required_gate_order: Integer estimate range→exact guess/product→lexicographic P<=N→borrow-subtracted remainder→residualHi0 and residualLo<d→sticky→same PB32Round sign/exponent and return.

arithmetic_and_profile_guards.exact_product: Actual OpUMulExtended result has the same two-uint structure and exact guess*d operands.
arithmetic_and_profile_guards.no_fabricated_named_WideProduct_comparis: PB32WideProduct has no named function in either actual module. Both absence and unchanged source intrinsic are bound; actual inline product graph is checked. The four other named function bodies are compared completely after ID normalization.
arithmetic_and_profile_guards.complete_original_fallback_suffix_retain: Original loop, digit division, sticky and final round/return suffix normalized equal; same original normalized m/d/sign/exponent join retained.
arithmetic_and_profile_guards.other_required_checks: Full descriptor/workgroup type/decorations, execution modes, ordered barrier operands, exact capability multisets, Int32-only/Float32+64 candidate, no FloatToInt, original one fallback loop and UInt32 divides.
arithmetic_and_profile_guards.normal32_policy: Original compiled/validated module and frozen builder policy remain immutable; no policy or validator rerun is substituted.

negative_controls.positive: One exact complete original candidate is required to pass.
negative_controls.scope: Complete immutable disassembly text mutations, including range mask/exponent, swapped/extra stores, pointer alias, load type/order, branch/switch side entrances, product comparison arms/limbs/denominator, numerator shift, borrow, residual bounds, sticky, round exponent and original fallback.
